title: How to Setup Upgrade/Downgrade Options for Membership Plans | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Setup Upgrade/Downgrade Options for Membership Plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000008978 The Available Upgrade Options settings control which membership plans appear on the Upgrade/Downgrade page for each member. This guide outlines the steps to enable and configure these settings within a Brilliant Directories website. How to Activate the "Available Upgrade Options" Settings Follow these steps: 1. Go to the Membership Plans Section Navigate to Finance » Membership Plans . Click Edit on the membership plan that requires configuration. 2. Open the Sign Ups & Upgrades Tab Click Sign Ups & Upgrades tab. Scroll down to find the section titled Change Plan – Upgrade/Downgrade Settings . Configuration Options Scroll down in the settings area to find the following options: 1. Upgrade Email Sent Choose an email template to send to members after they upgrade to this membership plan. Additional Option Send Copy of Email to Default Website Email Address If checked (default), the system sends a copy of the upgrade email to the site admin. Email Template Recommendations Upgrade Email (Template: upgrade-response ) Use when upgrading from a lower-tier plan. Downgrade Email (Template: downgrade-response ) Use when moving to a lower-tier plan, especially from the highest-tier plan. Generic Template Create a neutral template if this plan is both an upgrade and downgrade option. This keeps the message relevant regardless of direction. 2. After Upgrading to This Plan, Set Account Status As Choose the member's account status after the upgrade Active Account Member becomes active and visible on the site. Inactive Account Member remains inactive and hidden from the site. Same Status Before Upgrading Member retains the status they had before the upgrade. On Hold, Requires Admin Approval Member is on hold until manually approved by the admin. 3. Available Upgrade Options This is the key setting to control which plans members can upgrade or downgrade to. Available Plans Select the membership plans that should appear as upgrade/downgrade options. Pre-Selected Plan Choose the default selected upgrade option. Display Order Choose the order in which plans appear on the upgrade page. 4. Upgrade Page Header Content Enter a custom message or instruction that will appear above the upgrade options on the member’s Upgrade page. 5. Description Why Members Should Upgrade to This Level Add a description that explains the benefits of upgrading to this plan. This description will only be visible to members who are eligible to upgrade to this plan — not to those who are already on it. Note : This message will not display for members already in the plan. This description will not display for members already enrolled in Plan 1. 6. Free Trial when upgrading If the membership plan a member upgrades to includes a Free Trial, the free trial will also be applied during the upgrade process. This means members upgrading to that plan will receive the same trial period as they would during a new sign-up, according to the membership plan's Free Trial settings and this will show in the member dashboard when upgrading: 7. Card-Based Layout on Member Upgrade Page A new Advanced Setting is available to display the available membership plans in a card view instead of the standard list layout. When enabled, members will see the membership plan options presented as individual cards during the sign-up, upgrade, or downgrade process: Additional Notes Membership plans with the Account Type: "Claim" do not allow plan changes until the listing is claimed by a member. For more information about the member upgrade experience, see: Member Upgrades From Members’ Perception For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
